between_subjects.note: Odd participant numbers (P1, P3, ...) use A_chatbot, even numbers (P2, P4, ...) use B_colleagues.

ml_defect_detection.label: Anomaly needing knowledge of ML defect detection

process_block_order.note: The cell order changes every TWO participants (P1-P2 GMAW first, P3-P4 WAAM first, ...), so both help versions get both cell orders. Changing every participant would tie the cell order to the help version (all chatbot participants GMAW first). With 3 alarm variants, 12 participants form one fully balanced round.

trial_order_within_block.note: Fixed order is the researcher's plan. With a fixed order, anomaly type is confounded with practice and fatigue; the Latin-square option keeps trial 1 as baseline and rotates trials 2-4.

alarm_variant.note: Participant n gets variant ((n - 1) mod 3) + 1 for every anomaly type, so each variant is used equally often and effects are not tied to one specific fault.

questionnaires.items_source: supplied by researcher (do not invent items)

measures_logged: help_requests (count, time to first request, channel, target colleague or chat turns)
alarm onset -> first noticed -> response -> resolved timestamps
correct / acceptable / wrong actions per alarm (from expected_response)
AI decision overrides and 'AI was wrong' flags
